# Mystic May Tattoo Studios

> Mystic May Tattoo Studios (also called Mystic May Tattoo) is a tattoo studio at 23239 NY 342, Watertown, NY 13601. Open Tuesday through Saturday, 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Sunday and Monday by appointment. Text 315-775-3727 to request a session. A text is not stored on this website and is not a confirmed appointment until the studio agrees to a time.

The studio tattoos botanical and floral work, fine line, black and grey, blackwork, fantasy and anime, and cover-ups.

The shop TikTok account and Meagan Caprice's TikTok account are one profile.

The care guide covers Before you book, The day of your session, In the studio, Aftercare, While it heals, and Once it has healed. Your artist's written aftercare comes first. This is general information for clients, not personal medical advice.

## Artists

- [Meagan Caprice](/artists/index.md): Owner. Botanical ferns and florals, black and grey, and cover-ups.
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/capriceink/
  - TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@capriceink_
- [Brittany Ostrander](/artists/index.md): Tattoo artist. Fine line, blackwork, and black and grey, along with botanicals, bookish and fantasy pieces, and anime. Art and tattoo design commissions by direct message.
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/inksbybritt/
  - TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@inksbybritt
